text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Ever since I was little, I've loved<n>visiting
Tomakomai Port. Seeing the<n>big harbor, watching
the ships cut<n>across the sea towards us... it was<n>the
coolest.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Then there's Lake Utonai, with its<n>glassy surface
reflecting the beautiful<n>sky above. I'd sit there
forever and<n>ever, watching the migratory birds<n>swim
about.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
And the people around<n>town—everyone was so kind
when<n>they saw me out playing, giving me<n>batches
of homemade haskap jam.<n>And with so many
parks around, I<n>don't think I ever got bored.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
The Tomakomai in my memories was<n>such a
wonderful place... but I slowly<n>started noticing more
closed shutters<n>and empty lots.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
That's how it is. Tomakomai City...<n>My dear,
beloved home.

text_block_list.name: Haskap Farmer
text_block_list.text:
Oh, also! When I heard you'd be<n>goin' all the way
down to the<n>mainland, I had to do something. So, I
made you some business cards!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Huh? Business cards?

text_block_list.name: Haskap Farmer
text_block_list.text:
I was think'n they'd help you reach<n>your goals,
seein' as connections are<n>so import'nt. Now get
out there'n<n>meet a whole buncha lovely folks!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
...I, I will, thank you! I really appreciate<n>this! You
already gave me more<n>haskaps than I know what
to do with,<n>and now business cards too?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
...And I've got the sash everyone<n>gave me at the
send-off yesterday<n>too.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna do my absolute best out<n>there! I'll show
everyone down south<n>what makes Tomakomai so
special!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
I've been at Tracen for a little while<n>now. I'm out
exploring the town<n>when I spot a small crowd near
the<n>station.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Tomakomai... blanketed in<n>sheets... of
paper-white confetti. ♪ Ah,<n>Tomakomai... where
birds stop to<n>sleep, and rest their weary wings... ♪

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
...Again, I'm Hokko Tarumae, and that<n>was my new
song, "Stop On by<n>Tomakomai"!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for listen'n! ♪ I can't believe<n>how many
people are here. Tokyo's<n>such a warm, welcomin'
place!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Let me introduce myself! ☆ I'm your<n>paperwing
snowbird from Tomakomai<n>Port, I'm the biggest
shellfish<n>gourmet... And I'm Tomakomai's<n>local idol,
Hokko Tarumae! ♪

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Y'see, I actually juuust started tak'n<n>classes at
Tracen this spring, so I'm<n>still gett'n used to the big
city... Hehe,<n>but I'm glad t'meet ya!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
I don't remember seeing her around<n>the academy,
but now I'm curious.

text_block_list.name: Pedestrian A
text_block_list.text:
She's got such a pretty voice. And<n>she seems like
a really pure, sweet<n>girl! A street concert would be
the<n>perfect way to chill today.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Everyone's waiting for the idol to<n>sing her next
song, but for some<n>reason, when she opens her
mouth...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
All righty, next up... I've got a<n>Tomakomai quiz for
you! We all know<n>the Class B Yufutsu River, right?
Can<n>anyone tell me which river it merges<n>into?

text_block_list.name: Pedestrians
text_block_list.text: ...What?

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Instead of a song, we're hit with a<n>Hokkaido pop
quiz.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: And it doesn't stop there...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Next, I was think'n we could study<n>Tomakomai's
hist'ry together! ♪<n>People started develop'n the
area<n>back in the Meiji period.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
With ample access to water and<n>lumber, the
paper-mak'n trade<n>flourished. Tomakomai still
produces<n>a lot of Japan's newspaper sheets<n>today!

text_block_list.name: Pedestrian B
text_block_list.text: Oh... Uhh, okay?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Speak'n of which, I'd like to teach<n>you about
Tomakomai's local<n>specialties. I've got leaflets
here with<n>all my fav'rites. ♪

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
A buncha the shops've got online<n>stores now, so
you can buy stuff<n>from down here in Tokyo too.
Here,<n>lemme pass these out!

text_block_list.name: Pedestrian A
text_block_list.text:
H-hey, um, are you going to be<n>singing anything
else? I was kinda<n>hoping to hear more music...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Oh... I'm sorry! I just had the onesong, but what I do have comin' up isa whole buncha haskap berries foreveryone to try!

text_block_list.name: Pedestrian A
text_block_list.text: Ha-haskap berries? I see...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Yup, I love these berries like a fish<n>loves water! The
folks back home<n>gave me boxes n' boxes, but I'm
already down to the last one.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
I sure hope you all are gonna love<n>'em too. Here,
give one a try!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
She practically pushes the box into<n>my hands, and I
pop a berry into my<n>mouth. It's juicy and sour, with
a<n>light underlying sweetness.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Right?! And it makes amaz'n jam!Here, everyone else go ahead and...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Wha, wait?! Where'd everyone go?!<n>They all
vanished on me again...

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Most of the crowd dissipates when<n>they hear
there's not going to be a<n>street concert. Hokko
Tarumae<n>passes berries out to another<n>straggler or
two, then the impromptu<n>event is over...

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Her little song at the start was pretty<n>sweet, and it
was clear just how<n>passionate she is about her
hometown. She even brought berries<n>for everyone...
but I guess it's not<n>easy to build an audience.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: A few days later...

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
I can't get the taste off my mind. I<n>tried multiple
grocery stores, with no<n>luck. The local chains just
don't carry<n>haskap berries.
choice_data_list: But I need another taste... Wait, I know!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
I fish out the leaflet I got from Hokko<n>Tarumae,
and... bingo! It's got the<n>name and contact info for
the haskap<n>farm she got her berries from.

text_block_list.name: Haskap Farmer
text_block_list.text:
"Oh... Oh my! You heard about us at<n>Tarumae's
street show? That little<n>sweetheart—she's such a
hard<n>worker."

text_block_list.name: Haskap Farmer
text_block_list.text:
"...How was she gett'n on? She's<n>real serious
'bout her goals, so I just<n>can't help but worry..."
choice_data_list: It looked like she's learning through trial and error.

text_block_list.name: Haskap Farmer
text_block_list.text:
"Is that so? ...Hehe, then she's still<n>plugg'n away
at her dreams, huh?"

text_block_list.name: Haskap Farmer
text_block_list.text:
"She's a real insp'ration, that girl.<n>Why, I even
made an account on the<n>social medias to try my
own hand at<n>some PR!"

text_block_list.name: Haskap Farmer
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, but listen to me, rambl'n away.<n>Sorry about
that. I'll get your box of<n>haskaps shipped!"

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
When the box arrives, I get my fix of<n>the tart, juicy
goodness... and a<n>coupon for 10% off my next order.
